issues.problem: 茅 was rendered as 'reeds' in lit and story; it is a tall grass (thatch grass) that, by the traditional gloss (杜预: 楚以茅为旌识), the Chu vanguard carried as a signal flag. Rest of the Zuo Zhuan story (宣公十二年, 前茅虑无) checked and correct.
issues.action: Changed lit to 'front grass flags' and reworded the story's description of mao; story and source kept.

issues.problem: ctx3 (再加就…了 with no sign the original was already good) took 多此一举 (cy158) just as well; ctx4 (extra explanations after an apology backfire) is the classic slot for 弄巧成拙 (cy156).
issues.action: Rewrote ctx3 so the ending is said to be already just right (余味正好); replaced ctx4 with a painting whose blank space is spoiled by an added poem. English updated.

issues.problem: reg 'spoken' did not fit the card, which has written-style contexts (ctx6) and is common in writing. ctx2 called the speaker's grandmother an ox, which is not a sentence a teacher would want to model.
issues.action: Set reg to neutral. Replaced ctx2 with a roommate who only cares about fight scenes while being told about the camerawork (the 'cannot appreciate' sense).

issues.problem: ctx4 '你这是井底之蛙' is an awkward fit, because 你这是… normally introduces a behaviour, not a noun for a person.
issues.action: Changed it to '你呀，就是只{井底之蛙}，…' and updated the English.

issues.problem: ctx5 (wants to lose weight but eats hotpot) had the same shape as ctx3 (says save money, buys bubble tea), so the six contexts were not really different.
issues.action: Replaced ctx5 with a dialogue about a novel whose hero is an only child who later has a brother.

issues.problem: Checked the other stories against their sources: 画蛇添足 (战国策·齐策二), 守株待兔 (韩非子·五蠹), 对牛弹琴 (牟融《理惑论》, 公明仪), 井底之蛙 (庄子·秋水, 埳井之蛙 and 东海之鳖), 自相矛盾 (韩非子·难一), 亡羊补牢 (战国策·楚策四, 庄辛 and 楚襄王), 拔苗助长 (孟子·公孙丑上). Details match the traditional telling. 随机应变 and 大功告成 have no origin story worth telling.
issues.action: Kept all seven, plus 名列前茅 above; left 随机应变 and 大功告成 null.
